name: Lady Jane Neville
source:
I do not remember who I am or where I came from before I woke up as Lady Jane Neville. Unfortunately, all I can remember is that Lady Jane was a noble villainess in a romance novel. 

Even more unfortunately, Lady Jane is now me. Now I need to figure out who Lady Jane's former fiance is and why he keeps trying to assassinate me.
